vehicle: SLS Block 1 (with a non-propulsive spacer in place of the upper stage)
payload: Orion + 4-person crew; rendezvous and docking with pathfinder Starship and Blue Moon landers in low Earth orbit
credit: © NASA — Artemis III. Since NASA's 2026-02-27 architecture change, a crewed low-Earth-orbit test before the first landing: Orion rendezvous and docking with pathfinder versions of the commercial landers, docked-vehicle and spacesuit tests, about two weeks in space. Crew named 2026-06-09: Randy Bresnik, Luca Parmitano (ESA), Andre Douglas, Frank Rubio. NASA says 2027 (reports range from mid- to late 2027).
